prompt: You paint all faces of a cube with side $3$ ft. How many square feet?
hint: Paint covers the outside surfaces of the cube. Which measurement adds up the areas of all the faces?

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Paint one face at a time. One face takes $9$ square feet, two faces take $18$, and so on up to the last face.
Paint covers the outside surfaces of the cube. Which measurement adds up the areas of all the faces?
Each face is $3 \times 3 = 9$ square feet, and a cube has $6$ faces. Multiply those two numbers.

explanation: Painting every face means covering the whole surface area of the cube.
One face is a square with side $3$ ft, and its area is $3 \times 3 = 9$ square feet.
The cube has $6$ equal faces, so the total is $6 \times 9 = 54$.
You paint $54$ square feet in all.
